paper_title: Light Dark Matter Search with Ionization Signals in XENON1T
notes: XENON1T S2-only ionization search for absorption of bosonic dark matter. Dark photon (kinetic mixing κ) limit covers mχ 0.186-1 keV/c² (panel F of Fig. 5). Table I gives one explicit benchmark point: mχ=0.5 keV (500 eV), κ=2.2e-16 at 90% CL. The paper also constrains ALPs (g_ae=7.7e-14 at same mass, AxionElectron) and DM-nucleus/DM-electron scattering. Only one explicit dark photon numerical value is tabulated; full exclusion curve is in plot only.
